text:
vivian: Noticed build breaks on docs CI for PR #5501. The generate examples in api-ref/generate.yaml and guides/snippets.md diverge: examples show \"max_tokens\": \"30\" and a top-level \"input\": \"...\" string. Snippet validator expects numeric max_new_tokens and messages array.

kevin: Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5501

sarah: Oof. Which language snippets failed?

vivian: JS and curl fail in CI. Ruby and Go are stale too but the CI only runs the ones touched by the PR. Failing curl block from guides/snippets.md:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1","max_tokens":"30","input":"Summarize this..."}'
```
Should be normalized to:
```
{"model":"redwood-1","max_new_tokens":30,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this..."}]}
```
Add -H "Content-Type: application/json" to the curl sample.

kevin: Also saw the streaming example under samples/streaming.md returning SSE payloads like `data: {"role":"assistant","content":"hi"}`. The SDK stream parser expects `{\"type\":\"delta\",\"delta\":{...}}` envelope. That mismatch makes the client examples unusable.

sarah: I can patch this: convert max_tokens->max_new_tokens numeric, input->messages array, update streaming SSE to emit {"type":"delta","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"..."}}. Will add a small comment in api-ref/generate.yaml about legacy aliases `input/inputs` still accepted by runtime but docs show canonical `messages`.

vivian: Please also update api-ref/generate.yaml example to omit timeout_ms instead of setting a number; CI schema asserts nullable fields are optional and examples with concrete values keep failing for minor reason. Leave a TODO in the YAML if we need to discuss default behavior.

kevin: Can we add a snippet-linter rule to reject quoted numerics in JSON examples (snip-099)? That would have caught this before CI.

sarah: Adding snip-099 test and will run docs-lint locally. Also adding a CHANGELOG line in docs/changes.md referencing the snip id.

docs-bot: build-docs #1522 started for branch fix/examples-normalize (triggered by sarah)

kevin: One small ask: canonical field ordering in examples (model, messages, max_new_tokens, stop) helps visual diffs in PRs. Not necessary but helpful.

sarah: Good point — I'll reorder fields and keep examples consistent across languages. Also added Content-Type header to curl blocks I touched.

vivian: After patch, can someone run snippet-runner locally? CI runs are slow and we have a few other queued builds.

kevin: I'll run them. Also check community-contrib/ examples — they often linger with legacy shapes. Maybe add a short paragraph in CONTRIBUTING.md about example shapes.

sarah: Pushed change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/77d3fa1. Replaced quoted numerics, normalized messages, adjusted streaming SSE, omitted timeout_ms in examples, added snip-099, and CHANGELOG note.

ci-bot: docs-snippet-lint passed for PR 5501 locally (snip-099)

kevin: Ran the full snippet suite locally against that commit — JS, Python, Ruby, Go all green. Left a couple of tiny comments on formatting (non-blocking).

docs-bot: build-docs #1522 succeeded for branch fix/examples-normalize

vivian: CI green. Merged. Thanks all. Follow-up: open issue to add an automated docs-normalize precommit hook that coerces JSON values and flags legacy keys before PR. Also, add a short entry in PR_TEMPLATE.md reminding authors to run snippet-linter locally.

sarah: Will open the issue and link it in the merged PR description. Closing the thread.
